== Session videos on long-running deviceConnect hosts

Fixed an issue where sessions on a deviceConnect host stopped producing session videos after the host's video capture service had been running for an extended period. Sessions started and live view worked normally, but no video was available on the session detail page after the session ended. The issue affected every device on the host until the video capture service restarted.
